newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Fedex reviews options on Benelux fuel surcharge.
newsitem.headline: Fedex reviews options on Benelux fuel surcharge.

text.p: Federal Express is "reviewing its options" concerning the introduction of a fuel surcharge on shipments from Belgium and Luxemburg, a spokesman said.
"In the past we have not passed on charges to shippers. However, under the current conditions we are reviewing our options," he added.
If FedEx does introduce a surcharge, shippers will be disappointed, industry sources said.
OTM, the organisation of traffic managers, based in Brussels, has been urging its members to use integrators rather than the airlines because they have not introduced surcharges.
